description: Navigate the connected browser to a URL that the user asked for. Use it only for websites and accounts that the user owns or is authorized to use, and follow their terms. Stop at logins, MFA and CAPTCHAs and hand control to the user; this tool does not solve CAPTCHAs.

browserAddress.description: Optional websocket address for automatic reconnect if session state was lost

sessionId.description: Session ID of the connected browser

name: navigate_to_url
